## TemplateEngine.\_extractBlockNames() method

Extracts lowercase block tag names from an iterable of tag literals.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _extractBlockNames(blocks: Iterable<string>): Set<string>;
```

## Parameters

</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

Set&lt;string&gt;

Set of normalized lowercase block names

## Remarks

Strips leading `</` or `<`<!-- -->, any trailing `>`<!-- -->, any attributes that follow a space, and lowercases the result. Self-closing tags like `<g-import/>` are normalised to their bare name. Entries with attributes after a space (e.g. `<blockquote expandable>`<!-- -->) are returned with the attribute suffix preserved.

## Example


```typescript
const names = TemplateEngine._extractBlockNames([
  "<g-base>",
  "<g-import/>",
  "<BLOCKQUOTE expandable>"
]);
// => Set { "g-base", "g-import", "blockquote expandable" }
```
